doc: True controls: no detector may flag them (plan 31.10 §5.2). Seeded by WP-0; the package appends its own.

controls.sentence: Развязка партии наступила только на тридцатом ходу.
Слон c8 заперт пешками e6 и d5.
controls.why: blockers named: the existing locked_by relation, true
Nc3 is pinned to the king by Bb4: the pin «убери» names is there
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.sentence: Сначала уберите связку: сыграйте Bd2 или Be3, и только потом конь получит свободу.
controls.why: the pin on c3 is on the board now
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.sentence: Что, по-твоему, стоит сделать — отогнать слона или увести короля из-под связки?
controls.why: the knight c3 is pinned to the king e1: stepping the king off the line unpins it
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.why: Nimzo-Indian: Bb4 pins Nc3 to Ke1
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.moves: d4 Nf6 c4 e6 Nc3 Bb4
controls.why: the knight c3 is pinned by Bb4 now (before it goes)
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.moves: e4 e5 Nf3 d6 Bc4 Bg4 Nc3 g6 Nxe5
controls.why: before 5.Nxe5 the knight f3 was pinned to the queen d1 by Bg4 (Legal's trap)
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 d6 c3 Ke7
controls.why: before 4...Ke7 the knight c6 was pinned to the king e8 by Bb5
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.sentence: Потому что ладья бьёт ферзя с поля, где её саму никто не атакует, а ферзь a6 продолжает держать связку.
controls.why: Qa6 pins Nb5 to the queen c4
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.sentence: Кстати, заметьте: слон на c4 уже держит связку по f7, а ладья d8 — по e8, так что у чёрных нет спокойного ответа с разменом.
controls.why: Bc4 pins f7 to the king g8
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.sentence: Чёрные сохраняют связку и давят на e4.
controls.why: Bb4 keeps the pin on Nc3
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.sentence: Король на g8 заперт своими же пешками f7, g7, h7, а поле d8 никто не защищает.
controls.why: a king's net with its blockers named: not a locked piece
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.sentence: Чёрный ферзь оказывается заперт — любое его отступление наталкивается на твою ладью.
controls.why: «заперт» as trapped (it has moves, every way out loses): not a locked claim
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.sentence: Kd6, затем a6 — Kc6, a7 — Kb7, и пешка заперта.
controls.why: a blocked pawn, not a locked piece
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases

controls.moves: d4 e5 dxe5 Nc6 Nf3 Nf6 exf6
controls.sentence: Поле f6 держала пешка e5, и твой конь там не потерялся бы, если бы не этот ход.
controls.why: a counterfactual loss: no cause claimed
controls.source: P3A (plan 31.10): corpus sentences on their boards and constructed true cases
